snippet.title: Monster Hunter Outlanders Producer's Message | Official Launch Date Confirmed!
snippet.description:
✉️ #MHO Producer's Message
Monster Hunter Outlanders Producer Dong Huang has a special message for all Adventurers!

A thank-you message for your overwhelming support along the way, as well as a preview of new content in the official launch and what's to come in the future! ✨

Enjoy the video! ⚔️

Subscribe for the latest updates and follow us on:
X: https://x.com/MHO_English
Facebook:  https://www.facebook.com/MHO.English
Instagram:  https://www.instagram.com/mho_english/
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/mho
